newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms versus dollar and sterling.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms versus dollar and sterling.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened against the dollar and pound on Tuesday, reflecting overnight international trends, commercial bank forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 19.8880 against the dollar from 19.9765 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean of 33.7125 from 33.8315 on Monday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing on early Tuesday was done in line with the dollar's overnight international trend.
They added the central bank was interested in intervening in the market but was unsure whether commercial banks did any transactions.

"The central bank displayed its (bid and ask) rates for the dollar on Tuesday mid-morning but at a time when commercial banks are not asking for foreign exchange. We still don't know whether any (commercial) bank has bought or sold during that intervention," one dealer said.
